extracted.name: Ham Bone Soup
extracted.description: A simple but tasty soup to make using a leftover ham bone, kidney beans, and potatoes. Put it all into the slow cooker in the morning, and come home to a savory hot meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14.5 ounce) can peeled and diced tomatoes with juice
1 green bell pepper, seeded and cubed
instruction_lines: Place the ham bone, onion, tomatoes, kidney beans, potatoes, and green pepper into a 3 quart or larger slow cooker. Dissolve the bouillon cubes in water, and pour into the slow cooker.
Cover, and cook on High until warm. Reduce heat to Low, and continue to cook for 5 to 6 hours.
